content.rationale: structured requirements with a runnable artifact dependent: conformance is what running the artifact shows, so the gate states the observables the requirements demand and leaves the verdict to the run; vylxkuxr names the page and its interactivity without pinning the identity attribute or the page's own reference targets, so the check is deliberately structural there: it asserts that the attributes are distinct and non-empty and that every reference resolves, and takes no value from the artifact under evaluation
